response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_usage AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage AS margin_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;
